content: {"episode_id":"ep-05267","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), which was denied because required authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent unexplained syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings during daily activities. We request reconsideration based on this documented clinical indication."}
